neighbours.label: The token before a word for thickness or thinness: 'one atom', 'atom-th', French d'épaisseur, 'six inches'
fire: They grew a sheet of a single layer, one atom thin.
Le mur fait trente centimètres d'épaisseur.
The new coating is just one atom thick.
The steel plate is three inches thick.
La vitre fait deux millimètres d'épaisseur.
They made a one-atom-thick sheet of tin.
The wall is ten inches thick.
quiet: They grew a tree of a single kind, one year old.
Le mur fait trente mètres de long.
The new coating is just a bit shiny.
The steel plate is on the table.
They made a one-week trip to Tin Lake.
The wall is ten miles north.

predictions: The token before thick or thin fires; 'six inches away' would too (0.37 in a probe, since the token cannot see ahead), so near misses vary the lead-in.
